scripts.version: changeset version && bun scripts/replace-workspace-refs.ts && bunx biome format --write . && bun install
scripts.check:no-workspace-refs: bun -e "import {globSync,readFileSync} from 'node:fs';const bad=globSync('packages/*/package.json').filter(f=>readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('workspace:'));if(bad.length){console.error('workspace: refs found — run bun run version first:\n'+bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}"
scripts.release: bun run check:no-workspace-refs && bun run build && changeset publish
